## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issue
Closes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Affected Areas
- [ ] Frontend Application (`frontend/src/app`)
- [ ] UI Components (`frontend/src/components`)
- [ ] Styling & Global Tokens (`frontend/src/app/globals.css`)
- [ ] Backend Service (`backend/`)
- [ ] Configuration / Dependencies

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and guidelines.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code in complex areas where necessary.
- [ ] I have verified that `npm run lint` passes without errors.
- [ ] My changes do not generate new console warnings or errors.
- [ ] I have tested these changes across multiple viewport sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop).
